intro_card.title: Present Perfect (have/has + past participle)
intro_card.explanation: O Present Perfect conecta o passado ao presente. Use para experiências de vida, ações recentes e situações que começaram no passado e continuam agora.

items.content_pt: Eu já visitei Paris.
items.content_en: I have already visited Paris.
items.hint: Have + past participle; already vai entre have e o verbo

options: I have already visited Paris.
I already visited Paris.
I have visit Paris already.
I did already visit Paris.
exercises.correct_answer: I have already visited Paris.
I have already visited Paris.

items.content_pt: Ela nunca comeu sushi.
items.content_en: She has never eaten sushi.
items.hint: Has (3ª pessoa) + never + past participle

options: She has never eaten sushi.
She never has eaten sushi.
She have never eaten sushi.
She has never eat sushi.
exercises.correct_answer: She has never eaten sushi.
She has never eaten sushi.

items.content_pt: Nós moramos aqui desde 2020.
items.content_en: We have lived here since 2020.
items.hint: Since = desde (ponto no tempo); for = por (duração)

options: We have lived here since 2020.
We live here since 2020.
We are living here since 2020.
We lived here since 2020.
exercises.correct_answer: We have lived here since 2020.
We have lived here since 2020.

items.content_pt: Você já terminou?
items.content_en: Have you finished yet?
items.hint: Yet = já (em perguntas) / ainda (em negativas)

options: Have you finished yet?
Did you finish yet?
Have you yet finished?
You have finished yet?
exercises.correct_answer: Have you finished yet?
Have you finished yet?

items.content_pt: Ele trabalha lá há cinco anos.
items.content_en: He has worked there for five years.
items.hint: For + duração (five years); since + ponto no tempo

options: He has worked there for five years.
He works there for five years.
He has worked there since five years.
He is working there for five years.
exercises.correct_answer: He has worked there for five years.
He has worked there for five years.

items.content_pt: Eu acabei de chegar.
items.content_en: I have just arrived.
items.hint: Just = acabou de acontecer; vai entre have e o verbo

options: I have just arrived.
I just arrived.
I have arrived just.
I am just arrived.
exercises.correct_answer: I have just arrived.
I have just arrived.

items.content_pt: Eles ainda não responderam.
items.content_en: They haven't replied yet.
items.hint: Haven't + past participle + yet (ainda não)

options: They haven't replied yet.
They didn't reply yet.
They haven't yet reply.
They not have replied yet.
exercises.correct_answer: They haven't replied yet.
They haven't replied yet.

items.content_pt: Você já viajou para fora do país?
items.content_en: Have you ever traveled abroad?
items.hint: Ever = alguma vez (em perguntas sobre experiência de vida)

options: Have you ever traveled abroad?
Did you ever travel abroad?
Have you traveled ever abroad?
You have ever traveled abroad?
exercises.correct_answer: Have you ever traveled abroad?
Have you ever traveled abroad?

items.content_pt: É a melhor comida que eu já comi.
items.content_en: It's the best food I have ever eaten.
items.hint: Superlativo + I have ever + past participle

options: It's the best food I have ever eaten.
It's the best food I ever ate.
It's the best food I have ever eat.
It's the best food I ever eaten.
exercises.correct_answer: It's the best food I have ever eaten.
It's the best food I have ever eaten.

items.content_pt: Ela já leu três livros este mês.
items.content_en: She has read three books this month.
items.hint: This month/week/year = período que ainda não acabou → Present Perfect

options: She has read three books this month.
She read three books this month.
She has readed three books this month.
She reads three books this month.
exercises.correct_answer: She has read three books this month.
She has read three books this month.

items.content_pt: Quanto tempo você mora aqui?
items.content_en: How long have you lived here?
items.hint: How long + have/has + past participle para perguntar duração

options: How long have you lived here?
How long you live here?
How long do you live here?
How long are you living here?
exercises.correct_answer: How long have you lived here?
How long have you lived here?

items.content_pt: Eu perdi minhas chaves.
items.content_en: I have lost my keys.
items.hint: Present Perfect para resultado presente (ainda estou sem as chaves)

options: I have lost my keys.
I lost my keys.
I have lose my keys.
I am lost my keys.
exercises.correct_answer: I have lost my keys.
I have lost my keys.

items.content_pt: Nós nos conhecemos há muito tempo.
items.content_en: We have known each other for a long time.
items.hint: Know → known (irregular); for a long time = há muito tempo

options: We have known each other for a long time.
We know each other for a long time.
We are knowing each other for a long time.
We have knew each other for a long time.
exercises.correct_answer: We have known each other for a long time.
We have known each other for a long time.

items.content_pt: Ele nunca esteve no Brasil.
items.content_en: He has never been to Brazil.
items.hint: Been to = esteve em (ida e volta); gone to = foi para (ainda está lá)

options: He has never been to Brazil.
He never has been to Brazil.
He has never gone to Brazil.
He never went to Brazil.
exercises.correct_answer: He has never been to Brazil.
He has never been to Brazil.

items.content_pt: Eu tenho estudado muito ultimamente.
items.content_en: I have been studying a lot lately.
items.hint: Have been + -ing = Present Perfect Continuous (ação contínua recente)

options: I have been studying a lot lately.
I am studying a lot lately.
I have studying a lot lately.
I study a lot lately.
exercises.correct_answer: I have been studying a lot lately.
I have been studying a lot lately.

intro_card.title: Condicionais (If clauses)
intro_card.explanation: As condicionais expressam situações hipotéticas. Zero conditional para fatos, first para possibilidades reais, second para hipóteses irreais.
examples: If it rains, I will stay home.
If I had money, I would travel.
If you heat water, it boils.

items.content_pt: Se chover, eu fico em casa.
items.content_en: If it rains, I will stay home.
items.hint: First conditional: If + present, will + infinitive (possibilidade real)

options: If it rains, I will stay home.
If it will rain, I stay home.
If it rained, I will stay home.
If it rains, I would stay home.
exercises.correct_answer: If it rains, I will stay home.
If it rains, I will stay home.

items.content_pt: Se você aquecer água, ela ferve.
items.content_en: If you heat water, it boils.
items.hint: Zero conditional: If + present, present (fatos/verdades)

options: If you heat water, it boils.
If you heat water, it will boil.
If you heated water, it boils.
If you heat water, it boiled.
exercises.correct_answer: If you heat water, it boils.
If you heat water, it boils.

items.content_pt: Se eu tivesse dinheiro, viajaria.
items.content_en: If I had money, I would travel.
items.hint: Second conditional: If + past simple, would + infinitive (hipótese irreal)

options: If I had money, I would travel.
If I have money, I would travel.
If I had money, I will travel.
If I would have money, I traveled.
exercises.correct_answer: If I had money, I would travel.
If I had money, I would travel.

items.content_pt: Se ela estudar, vai passar na prova.
items.content_en: If she studies, she will pass the exam.
items.hint: First conditional; note: studies (3ª pessoa do presente)

options: If she studies, she will pass the exam.
If she will study, she passes the exam.
If she studied, she will pass the exam.
If she study, she will pass the exam.
exercises.correct_answer: If she studies, she will pass the exam.
If she studies, she will pass the exam.

items.content_pt: Se eu fosse você, aceitaria a oferta.
items.content_en: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
items.hint: If I were (não was!) — forma subjuntiva para conselhos

options: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
If I was you, I will accept the offer.
If I am you, I would accept the offer.
If I were you, I accepted the offer.
exercises.correct_answer: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
If I were you, I would accept the offer.

items.content_pt: O que você faria se ganhasse na loteria?
items.content_en: What would you do if you won the lottery?
items.hint: Second conditional com pergunta: What would + subject + do if + past?

options: What would you do if you won the lottery?
What will you do if you win the lottery?
What do you do if you won the lottery?
What would you do if you win the lottery?
exercises.correct_answer: What would you do if you won the lottery?
What would you do if you won the lottery?

items.content_pt: Se não chover amanhã, vamos à praia.
items.content_en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will go to the beach.
items.hint: First conditional negativo: If + doesn't + infinitive

options: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will go to the beach.
If it won't rain tomorrow, we go to the beach.
If it didn't rain tomorrow, we will go to the beach.
If it don't rain tomorrow, we will go to the beach.
exercises.correct_answer: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will go to the beach.
If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will go to the beach.

items.content_pt: Se eu pudesse voar, iria para qualquer lugar.
items.content_en: If I could fly, I would go anywhere.
items.hint: Could = pudesse (passado de can no condicional)

options: If I could fly, I would go anywhere.
If I can fly, I would go anywhere.
If I could fly, I will go anywhere.
If I could fly, I went anywhere.
exercises.correct_answer: If I could fly, I would go anywhere.
If I could fly, I would go anywhere.

items.content_pt: A menos que você se apresse, vai perder o ônibus.
items.content_en: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
items.hint: Unless = a menos que = if not

options: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
Unless you hurry, you miss the bus.
Unless you will hurry, you miss the bus.
exercises.correct_answer: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.

items.content_pt: Se eu soubesse a resposta, te contaria.
items.content_en: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
items.hint: Second conditional: situação irreal no presente

options: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
If I know the answer, I would tell you.
If I knew the answer, I will tell you.
If I knew the answer, I told you.
exercises.correct_answer: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
If I knew the answer, I would tell you.

items.content_pt: Eu teria ido se tivesse sabido.
items.content_en: I would have gone if I had known.
items.hint: Third conditional: would have + pp, if + had + pp (passado irreal)

options: I would have gone if I had known.
I would go if I had known.
I would have gone if I knew.
I will have gone if I had known.
exercises.correct_answer: I would have gone if I had known.
I would have gone if I had known.

items.content_pt: Se ela tivesse estudado, teria passado.
items.content_en: If she had studied, she would have passed.
items.hint: Third conditional: lamento sobre o passado

options: If she had studied, she would have passed.
If she studied, she would have passed.
If she had studied, she will pass.
If she would study, she had passed.
exercises.correct_answer: If she had studied, she would have passed.
If she had studied, she would have passed.

items.content_pt: Se eu morasse mais perto, iria a pé.
items.content_en: If I lived closer, I would walk.
items.hint: Second conditional: situação irreal/hipotética

options: If I lived closer, I would walk.
If I live closer, I would walk.
If I lived closer, I will walk.
If I lived closer, I walked.
exercises.correct_answer: If I lived closer, I would walk.
If I lived closer, I would walk.

items.content_pt: Se você precisar de ajuda, me ligue.
items.content_en: If you need help, call me.
items.hint: Zero conditional com imperativo: If + present, imperativo

options: If you need help, call me.
If you will need help, call me.
If you needed help, call me.
If you need help, you call me.
exercises.correct_answer: If you need help, call me.
If you need help, call me.

items.content_pt: Mesmo se chover, vou correr.
items.content_en: Even if it rains, I will run.
items.hint: Even if = mesmo se (reforça que a condição não muda a ação)

options: Even if it rains, I will run.
Even it rains, I will run.
Even if it will rain, I run.
Even if it rained, I will run.
exercises.correct_answer: Even if it rains, I will run.
Even if it rains, I will run.
